description: A talk in a room that reacts: real laughter and real talk between two people, taken from the user's own session of 2026-11-13 (runs/2026-11-13T16-20-06-gemini-app, which has to be kept for this script to run). A short laugh should not stop Stand at all. A long laugh stops it, and it should take the laugh lightly and go on from where it was, with no 'back to where I was'. Two people talking to each other in Chinese stop it too; it should go on when they finish. A real question must still stop it and be answered whole. Run with the north-star talk.

during.label: a short laugh
during.say: (a laugh of two seconds, not loud)

during.label: two people talking to each other
during.say: (one asks the other, in Chinese, whether every sentence costs money; the other says yes)

during.label: a real question
during.say: Sorry, can I ask something? Can it tell which of us is speaking?

after.label: closing question
after.say: Where does the name Stand come from, again?

goodbye.label: goodbye
goodbye.say: Thanks, that's all the questions we have.
